title: Three Doors Tutorial
summary: A deterministic tutorial level where the player inspects three doors and chooses the one matching a clue.

objective.win: Submit the door marked with the symbol that matches the clue.
objective.loss: Submit two incorrect answers or exceed ten turns.

rules: The clue is visible from the first turn.
The correct door does not change during play.
The player may inspect any door before submitting an answer.
The level ends immediately after a correct answer.
acceptance_criteria: A human can identify the valid actions from the manifest.
An agent can identify observations and produce a valid action object.
The level has deterministic terminal conditions.
